editions.title: AI Model Watch — 2026-10-16
editions.lead: This first edition covers 46 days and logs 21 releases, deprecations and policy notices from the providers we track, each linked to its source. 10 items include a published safety or welfare disclosure, such as the system cards for GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon. We summarise what providers say, link each source, and do not assess it. The benchmark's own measurement in this window was limited to unofficial pilot runs, which are not scores.
